# File summary mode

Summarize the selected target. Include:
- Purpose and primary responsibilities
- Public API surface (functions, types, commands)
- Dependencies and notable interactions
- Links to canonical context in `.claude/` when relevant

Keep it under 200 words unless asked for more.
